about: The trainer AI does not try to hold a Ghost-type. From the sixth generation nothing holds one (Battler_HasGhostType), and flag 0 marks down Mean Look, Block, Spider Web and Octolock against one (trainer_ai_script.c, 2987). Falkner's Hoothoot is taught Mean Look, Octolock and Leer once the battle is up (teach:) and faces a Gengar that only Splashes: it Leers every turn. Before the fix the three scored the same and it tried the two that fail.
